title: Admin role evasion risk
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The function `AccountModule::revokeAccountPermission` is designed to remove permissions from a user. However, a malicious admin could preemptively execute a front-run by calling `AccountModule::grantAccountPermission` to assign admin permissions to another controlled account before their own permissions are revoked.
